The file that builds the enum name→constant lookup used during enum deserialization is:

**`gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/EnumTypeAdapter.java`**

Specifically, the constructor (lines 64–111) builds the `nameToConstant` map. For each enum constant it reads the `@SerializedName` annotation (line 95) and, when present, iterates `annotation.alternate()` and does `nameToConstant.put(alternate, constant)` (lines 96–101) — this is the alternate-name handling that needs fixing for the reported bug.
